**Severity:** error · **Area:** Styles (`RV5xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads one of:

```text
css`` must initialize a top-level const (const styles = css`…`)
```

```text
css`` interpolations are not supported: write values literally; for a dynamic value set a custom property on the element (style={{ "--x": value }}) and read var(--x) in the block; for states define a class per state and pick it with class:active={on} or cx(styles.base, on && styles.active), or select on a data-* attribute (.card[data-size="lg"])
```

```text
css`` class maps are read-only
```

```text
Unknown class '{key}' in css`` block {binding}
```

Parts in braces (`{name}`) are filled in for each report.

## How to fix

Read only classes defined in the block (s.a for .a), declare css`` as a top-level const, never assign to it, and replace $`{}` interpolations with custom properties (`style={{ "--x": v }}` + `var(--x)`).

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
import { css } from "@rivetjs/runtime/css";
const s = css`.a { color: red }`;
export const A = () => <p class={s.b} />;
```

```tsx prefer
import { css } from "@rivetjs/runtime/css";
const s = css`.a { color: red }`;
export const A = () => <p class={s.a} />;
```

## When it is reported

Build only (styles option). Unknown-class variant could list defined classes.
